name: Belt of Endless Pouches
body:
Price 6,000 gp; Aura moderate conjuration; CL 5; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This unassuming belt has what seems like a dozen tiny pouches adorned across its surface. In fact there are 24 pockets, 12 on the outside and 12 on the inside. Each pocket holds 1 cubic foot of material but items stored in the belt do not count against the wearer’s carrying capacity.
